name: mcp-use
description: Build MCP servers and MCP-powered apps from one fullstack framework — connect any LLM to any MCP server, or ship agent-facing apps for Claude and ChatGPT.

skills.name: Multi Server Client
skills.description: Connects one agent to several MCP servers at once and routes each tool call to the server that owns it.

skills.name: Server Scaffolding
skills.description: Generates a typed MCP server project with tool, resource, and prompt handlers wired up and ready to run.

skills.name: LLM Agnostic Binding
skills.description: Binds MCP toolsets to any LangChain-compatible model so the same server works across providers unchanged.
